module: Shared enumerations of the rally system (co-driver notes): pacenote audio mode, trigger type, release type for slow corners, with their readable names. These are constant tables used by the note editor and by the rally engine; the file contains no functions.
notes: The numeric values are persisted in the notebooks: do not renumber them.
Several triggerType and slowCornerReleaseType values are commented out in the code (csStatic, csHalf, ceMinus5, ceStatic for triggerType) and therefore unavailable.
slowCornerReleaseType: steps of 10 (10 to 50); csHalf (30) is the default value according to its label.

pacenoteAudioMode.desc: Audio modes: auto=1, freeform=2, structuredOnline=3, structuredOffline=4, custom=5.

pacenoteAudioModeNames.desc: Technical name of each audio mode, keyed by value.

pacenoteAudioModeDisplayNames.desc: Names shown to the user (editor, debug); structuredOffline is displayed as 'structured'.

pacenoteAudioModeHidden.desc: Modes hidden in the choice lists (freeform, structuredOnline) but still functional for existing notebooks.

triggerType.desc: Trigger types of a note: dynamic=1, csImmediate=15.

triggerTypeName.desc: Labels of the trigger types ('dynamic (default)', 'immediate (only use for first pacenote)').

slowCornerReleaseType.desc: Release moment of a slow corner note: csStaticMinus40=10, csStatic=20, csHalf=30, ceMinus5=40, ceStatic=50.

slowCornerReleaseTypeName.desc: Matching labels (e.g. '40m before corner start', 'at corner end').
